# package scl

```go
import "github.com/otfabric/go-iec61850/scl"
```

Package scl provides parsing and inspection of IEC 61850 SCL (Substation Configuration Language) files.

SCL is an XML schema defined in IEC 61850-6 used to describe the configuration of IEC 61850 systems, including IEDs (Intelligent Electronic Devices), logical devices, logical nodes, data objects, data sets, and report control blocks.

This package parses SCD, ICD, CID, and IID file formats into a Go-native model that can be queried, flattened for CLI/CSV output, or used for runtime validation against a live server.

## Functions

### func Generate

```go
func Generate(w io.Writer, s *SCL) error
```

Generate writes an SCL model as XML to the given writer.

The output is deterministic: elements appear in the order they are stored in the model slices. Round-trip loss is minimal for the supported SCL subset (Header, Substation, Communication, IED, DataTypeTemplates).

### func PrintTree

```go
func PrintTree(w io.Writer, s *SCL) error
```

PrintTree writes a hierarchical text representation of the SCL model to the given writer.

### func WriteCSV

```go
func WriteCSV(w io.Writer, rows []FlatRow) error
```

WriteCSV writes flattened rows as CSV to the given writer using [encoding/csv](https://pkg.go.dev/encoding/csv). The first line is the header row.

#### func Validate

```go
func Validate(s *SCL) []Diagnostic
```

Validate performs semantic validation on an SCL model beyond basic parsing. It checks cross-references, type chains, logical consistency, topology LNode references and required attributes.

Deprecated: Use \[validate.All] from the scl/validate package for pass-based validation with a shared index. This function is kept for convenience but may not cover all checks that the pass-based validator provides.

#### func ValidateKind

```go
func ValidateKind(s *SCL, kind DocumentKind) []Diagnostic
```

ValidateKind reports content a document of the given kind must have (IEC 61850-6, SCL file types): an ICD, IID or CID describes an IED, so it has at least one IED section; an ICD or IID describes exactly one (vendor CIDs also carry their client IEDs, so CID is not limited); an SSD specifies a substation. KindUnknown and KindSCD add nothing.

#### func ValidateRequired

```go
func ValidateRequired(s *SCL) []Diagnostic
```

ValidateRequired reports required attributes that are missing or empty. The attributes are those the IEC 61850-6 SCL schemas (specs/, 2007B4) declare use="required" with a type that cannot be empty (tName, tID, a pattern requiring a first character, an enumeration). Left out: Header id (xs:normalizedString, may be empty), LN inst (empty on LN0) and numeric attributes, whose absence cannot be told from their zero value. A parsed document without a Header element is reported too (missing-element, from [DocumentMetadata.HasHeader](#func-documentmetadata-hasheader)); a model built in code has no metadata and is not checked for it.

### type DocumentKind

```go
type DocumentKind string
```

DocumentKind describes the type of an SCL document based on its file extension or content heuristics.

```go
const (
	KindUnknown DocumentKind = "unknown"
	KindSCD     DocumentKind = "scd"
	KindCID     DocumentKind = "cid"
	KindICD     DocumentKind = "icd"
	KindIID     DocumentKind = "iid"
	KindSSD     DocumentKind = "ssd"
)
```

#### func DetectKind

```go
func DetectKind(s *SCL) DocumentKind
```

DetectKind infers the document kind from the model's content. This is more reliable than file-extension heuristics.

Classification rules:

  - SSD: substations present but no IEDs
  - ICD: exactly 1 IED, no communication bindings
  - IID: exactly 1 IED, no communication bindings (same as ICD)
  - CID: exactly 1 IED, has communication bindings
  - SCD: multiple IEDs, or 1+ IEDs with substations
  - unknown: empty or unclassifiable

#### func Flatten

```go
func Flatten(s *SCL) []FlatRow
```

Flatten expands an SCL model into a flat list of rows, one per data attribute. Each row represents a leaf data attribute with its full path through the IEC 61850 hierarchy.

Type resolution uses the DataTypeTemplates to expand LNodeType → DOType → DA/SDO chains. Attributes whose types cannot be resolved are still emitted with available metadata.

### type ParseOptions

```go
type ParseOptions struct {
	// ValidateSemantic runs semantic validation after parsing and
	// appends any findings to the result diagnostics.
	ValidateSemantic bool

	// Strict, when true, causes parsing to return an error if any
	// diagnostic has error severity (including semantic validation
	// errors when ValidateSemantic is enabled).
	Strict bool

	// Kind overrides automatic document kind detection.
	// When empty, the kind is inferred from the file extension
	// or content.
	Kind DocumentKind

	// MaxDiagnostics, when > 0, truncates the diagnostic list
	// to at most this many entries.
	MaxDiagnostics int

	// AssumeSCLNamespace, when true, reads an SCL root element without a
	// namespace as if it declared the IEC 61850-6 namespace
	// (http://www.iec.ch/61850/2003/SCL). The SCL schema requires the
	// namespace, so such a document is refused by default; with this
	// option it is parsed and a warning diagnostic with code
	// "namespace-assumed" is added. Without version attributes the
	// document is then read as the 2003 schema (1.7). A root in any other
	// namespace is still refused.
	AssumeSCLNamespace bool
}
```

ParseOptions controls the behavior of [ParseBytes](#func-parsebytes) and [ParseFileOpts](#func-parsefileopts).

#### func ParseBytes

```go
func ParseBytes(data []byte, opts ParseOptions) (*Result, error)
```

ParseBytes parses raw SCL XML bytes and returns a [Result](#type-result) containing the normalized model, version info, document kind, and any diagnostics.

It detects the schema version from the root element, dispatches to the correct versioned raw type for unmarshalling, and converts the result into the normalized [SCL](#type-scl) model.

### type SCL

```go
type SCL struct {
	// Metadata holds parse-time information about the document
	// (schema version, document kind, vendor namespaces).
	// It is populated by ParseBytes / ParseFileOpts.
	Metadata *DocumentMetadata

	// Header contains version and revision metadata.
	Header Header

	// Substations contains substation topology definitions.
	Substations []Substation

	// Communication contains network and addressing information.
	Communication *Communication

	// IEDs is the list of Intelligent Electronic Devices defined in
	// the SCL file.
	IEDs []IED

	// DataTypeTemplates contains the type definitions (LNodeType,
	// DOType, DAType, EnumType) referenced by data attributes.
	DataTypeTemplates DataTypeTemplates
}
```

SCL is the root element of an SCL configuration file.

```go
	Version17      SchemaVersion = "1.7"
	Version2007B   SchemaVersion = "2007B"
	Version2007B4  SchemaVersion = "2007B4"
	Version2007C5  SchemaVersion = "2007C5"
)
```

### type SettingControl

```go
type SettingControl struct {
	NumOfSGs uint8

}
```

SettingControl represents the SCL SettingControl element that defines setting group parameters for a logical node (LLN0).

### type SmvOpts

```go
type SmvOpts struct {
	RefreshTime        bool
	SampleSynchronized bool
	SampleRate         bool
	DataSet            bool // Edition 2 and later
	Security           bool
	Timestamp          bool // Edition 2 and later
	SynchSourceID      bool // 2007B4 and later
	SampleMode         bool // 2007C5
	DataRef            bool // Edition 1 only
}
```

SmvOpts lists the optional ASDU fields a Sampled Values control block sends. Flags an SCL edition does not define stay false.

### type Value

```go
type Value struct {
	Value  string
	SGroup uint32
}
```

Value is one Val element of SCL: a value as text and, for a setting, the setting group it belongs to (sGroup; 0 when absent).

### type VersionInfo

```go
type VersionInfo struct {
	Schema     SchemaVersion
	Namespace  string
	Version    string // raw "version" attribute (e.g. "2007")
	Revision   string // raw "revision" attribute (e.g. "B")
	Release    string // raw "release" attribute (e.g. "4")
	ReleaseNum int    // parsed numeric release; -1 when absent, 0 when malformed

	Confidence       Confidence
	Reasons          []string
	VendorNamespaces []string
}
```

VersionInfo holds the detected schema version information extracted from the root SCL element.

#### func DetectFile

```go
func DetectFile(path string) (VersionInfo, error)
```

DetectFile is a convenience wrapper that reads a file and detects its SCL schema version.

#### func DetectVersion

```go
func DetectVersion(data []byte) (VersionInfo, error)
```

DetectVersion sniffs the SCL schema version from raw XML data.

It streams tokens until the first StartElement, verifies it is an SCL root, reads only the element's attributes (without calling DecodeElement), and stops immediately. The full document is never parsed.
